size.description: Controls the diameter of the spinner. Matches USWDS icon size scale (1–9).

color.description: USWDS color token applied as text-{color}, e.g. 'primary', 'white', 'accent-cool'.

omitLabel.description: Set to true to omit the sr-only label, e.g. when wrapped in a Tooltip.

className.description: Additional CSS classes on the wrapper element.
